_doc: Claude Code plugins and skills the system uses. install_skills.py installs every entry with method plugin/git/npx. Entries with method 'manual' cannot be redistributed (paid licence or unknown source): each teammate gets them from the owner. Keep in sync with TOOLS-REGISTRY.md.
